questions.question: What is the working principle of an ultrasonic interferometer?
When do we note the reading on micrometer scale?

answers.a: When the current in ammeter reaches minima
answers.b: When the current in ammeter reaches to a maxima
answers.c: When the current in ammeter becomes zero
